snapshot.reason: The company signed a memorandum of understanding for a massive 3200 MW thermal power project, providing long-term revenue visibility and government-backed capital deployment.
snapshot.why_now: The official press release regarding the MoU was issued on October 22, 2026.
source_headlines: NLC India Limited: NLC India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 22, 2026, titled "NLCIL Signs MoU with IPICOL for Establishment of a 3200 MW (4x800 MW)Ultra Super Critical coal-based thermal power plant and Exploration of CoalGasification-Based Fertilizer Production and Beach Sand Mineral ProcessingFacility in Odisha".
